description: This file contains utility functions and data structures for type promotion in torchfuzz operators, including promotion chains, dtype mapping, and promotion pair generation.

methods.name: get_promoted_dtypes
methods.description: Generates two data types that promote to the target dtype according to PyTorch's promotion rules.

methods.name: get_dtype_name
methods.description: Returns the string name of a given torch dtype.

methods.name: get_promotion_table_for_strings
methods.description: Provides a promotion table with string dtype names for backward compatibility.

methods.name: get_dtype_map
methods.description: Returns a mapping from string dtype names to torch dtype objects.

methods.name: get_scalar_promotion_pairs
methods.description: Returns a list of dtype pairs that promote to the target dtype for scalar operations.
